note: Every production carries a stable id, the locators it implements, this grammar's own normalization rule, the AST node it produces, the engine capability it needs, its boundary, and the two fixtures it is promoted on: a golden clause it must compile and a near-miss it must not match.

productions.boundary: Only the two printed timing keywords. A timing granted by an effect is not this production.
golden: [Action]
[Reaction]
negative: [Action] this turn
action

productions.boundary: A bare printed keyword on the object. Granting a keyword to something else is a different production.
golden: [Tank]
[Shield]
[Ganking]
[Deflect]
negative: gains [shield 2] this combat
[unknown]

productions.boundary: The controller draws. 'Each player draws' and 'draw until' are not this production.
golden: Draw 1.
Draw 2.
negative: each player draws 1
draw 1, then discard 1

productions.form: Deal N to a unit at a battlefield.
productions.boundary: One chosen Unit at a Battlefield. A Might restriction on the target is a different production.
golden: Deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield.
Deal 3 to a unit at battlefield.
negative: deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield with 3 [m] or less
deal 2 to all units at a battlefield

productions.form: Deal N to all enemy units at a battlefield.
productions.pattern: deal (?P<amount>\d+) to all enemy units at a battlefield
productions.boundary: One chosen Battlefield, then every enemy Unit there. 'All units' without the relation is a different production.
golden: Deal 3 to all enemy units at a battlefield.
negative: deal 3 to all units at a battlefield
deal 3 to all enemy units in combat

productions.form: Deal N to all enemy units in combat.
productions.pattern: deal (?P<amount>\d+) to all enemy units in combat
productions.boundary: The Combat in progress. Outside one the instruction finds nothing; it does not fall back to a Battlefield.
golden: Deal 2 to all enemy units in combat.
negative: deal 2 to all enemy units at a battlefield
deal 2 to all units in combat

productions.form: Deal N to all units at battlefields.
productions.pattern: deal (?P<amount>\d+) to all units at battlefields
productions.boundary: Every Unit at every Battlefield, friend and enemy alike, and none in a Base.
golden: Deal 3 to all units at battlefields.
negative: deal 3 to all enemy units at a battlefield
deal 3 to all units at a battlefield

productions.boundary: Entering exhausted. A Channel with no entry state, or one that names a Rune, is a different production.
golden: Channel 1 rune exhausted.
negative: channel 1 rune
channel 1 rune ready

productions.form: Return a unit from your trash to your hand.
productions.pattern: return a unit from your trash to your hand
productions.boundary: A Unit, from the controller's own Trash. A spell, or an opponent's Trash, is a different production.
golden: Return a unit from your trash to your hand.
negative: return a spell from your trash to your hand
return a unit at a battlefield to its owner's hand

productions.form: Give a friendly unit +N [M] this turn.
productions.pattern: give a friendly unit \+(?P<amount>\d+) \[m\] this turn
productions.boundary: One chosen friendly Unit, for this turn. A second linked grant is a different production.
golden: Give a friendly unit +3 :rb_might: this turn.
negative: give a friendly unit +1 [m] this turn, then an additional +1 [m] this turn if it is the only unit you control there
give an enemy unit +3 [m] this turn

productions.form: While you have N+ runes, I have +M [M].
productions.pattern: while you have (?P<runes>\d+)\+ runes, i have \+(?P<amount>\d+) \[m\]
productions.boundary: A condition on the controller's own Runes on the board. Any other condition is a different production.
golden: While you have 8+ runes, I have +4 :rb_might:.
negative: while i'm attacking or defending alone, i have +2 [m]
while you have 8+ runes, i have [tank]

productions.form: Units you play this turn enter ready.
productions.pattern: units you play this turn enter ready
productions.boundary: Entry state for this turn's own plays. Another entry state, or another duration, is a different production.
golden: Units you play this turn enter ready.
negative: units you play this turn enter exhausted
i enter ready

productions.boundary: A card with nothing to compile. It is a parsed clause, not an unparsed one.
golden: (no rules text)
negative: no rules text
(vanilla)

productions.boundary: Wraps one instruction this grammar already has. An unparsed instruction makes the whole clause unparsed.
golden: When you play me, channel 1 rune exhausted.
When you play me, deal 3 to all units at battlefields.
negative: when you play a unit, draw 1
when i move, draw 1

productions.boundary: Wraps one instruction this grammar already has.
golden: When I move, draw 1.
negative: when a unit moves, draw 1
when you play me, draw 1

productions.form: At the end of your turn, <instruction>.
productions.pattern: at the end of your turn, (?P<inner>.+)
productions.boundary: Wraps one instruction this grammar already has. 'At the end of each turn' is a different production.
golden: At the end of your turn, draw 1.
negative: at the end of each turn, draw 1
at the beginning of your turn, draw 1
